product.name: Cat6 24AWG UTP Ethernet Network Patch Cable - Snagless Boot 3ft Black
product.description: Cat6 24AWG UTP Ethernet Network Patch Cable - Snagless Boot, 3ft, BlackBring fast, reliable Gigabit connectivity to any device with this 3ft Black Cat6 24AWG UTP Ethernet® Network Patch Cable. Built with four twisted pairs of 24AWG stranded bare copper, this cable supports bandwidth up to 250MHz and delivers the headroom you need for streaming, gaming, large file transfers, and PoE+ powered devices like access points, IP cameras, and VoIP phones. Each end is terminated with a precision-molded RJ45 plug featuring 50-micron gold-plated contacts that resist corrosion and preserve signal integrity over the life of the cable, while the signature clear, snagless strain-relief boot shields the locking tab from breakage when you plug, unplug, or pull the cable through a tight wall plate. The 3-foot length covers most desk-to-wall-jack and router-to-modem connections without leaving messy excess cable behind your equipment. Wired to the T-568B standard and verified to ANSI/TIA-568.2-D by both UL® and ETL, this black patch cable is a clean, professional-grade choice for home networks, offices, server rooms, and
